matches.ordinance_title: California Implied Warranty of Habitability & Rent Demand Bar
matches.text: Bars landlords from demanding rent, increasing rent, or serving a 3-day pay-or-quit notice when an official building/housing citation for untenantable residential conditions (missing heat, hot water, weatherproofing, plumbing, or safe wiring) remains unabated past 35 days.

funds.program_name: Proposition F Tenant Right to Counsel & Habitability Defense
funds.why: Residential; open DBI habitability case on her block (SF-202665044). Confirm a unit-level DBI complaint.
funds.bulletin_text: Pairs full unlawful detainer legal representation with habitability rent-abatement motions and up to $6,000 in stipulation bridges for residential tenants with an active open Department of Building Inspection habitability complaint.

funds.program_name: San Francisco Emergency Rental Assistance Program (SF ERAP)
funds.administering_agency: San Francisco Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development
funds.why: No open case required. Eligible if household is at or below 80% AMI (priority at or below 30%).
funds.bulletin_text: Covers up to $12,000 across six months of residential rental arrears or move-in deposits for San Francisco renter households at or below 80% of Area Median Income (AMI), prioritizing families <=30% AMI.

funds.program_name: Code Enforcement Relocation & Mold Remediation Bridge
funds.administering_agency: SF Department of Building Inspection Tenant Relocation Fund
funds.why: Requires an open, un-abated DBI notice on her unit. The block record is not her unit: file a 311/DBI complaint today.
funds.bulletin_text: Provides temporary hotel/relocation stipends up to $8,500 exclusively for residential apartment tenants whose unit has an open un-abated DBI notice for no heat, raw sewage, or toxic mold.
